claim: Scripted recordings reward reaching rooms and code, not keys beyond movement, so they can miss a path (such as a wrong colour) that a human recording finds quickly.

evidence.text: A second colour path beside the paint: a human recording released the sphere within three minutes and showed a figure in the wrong colour; ten scripted recordings never did.
evidence.quote: three minutes and showed a figure in the wrong colour; ten scripted recordings never did.
